audit_item: A04 / M0.3 WFO per-split market payload isolation
reproduction: WFO startup decoded the market source from data_start_ns through holdout_end before any fold query gate. The application’s default HistoricalEnvironmentFactory also used read_curated for candidate Validation, stress Validation, Test baselines, Test, and Holdout, allowing one stage’s read to materialize unrelated later scopes.
change: WFO startup now reads only the frozen COMPLETE source identity and rules-file hash. Candidate Train and final retrain use registered Train windows; Validation and stress Validation use their fold warmup-to-end scope; Test and its baselines use the Test fold warmup-to-end scope; final Holdout uses its own warmup-to-end scope. Formal backtest consumes EvaluationAccess before opening its exact frozen scope. Bundle/report dataset identity is digest([rles.wfo-market-plus-rules-dataset.v1, market_snapshot_hash, rules_sha]); the one-shot Holdout ledger remains bound to market source identity and timestamps.
